pincode.description: You can lock the app with a pincode if you'd like. Be warned that the only way to reset a forgotten code is to erase all your data, so be careful not to forget.

lock_screen.confirm: Please re-enter your passcode to confirm.
lock_screen.reset_warning: If you reset your PIN, some local access may be affected.
lock_screen.wrong_pin: That PIN didn't match. Try again.
lock_screen.setup_intro_body: FreeCBT will ask for your PIN when the app is opened. This helps protect private thoughts on this device.
lock_screen.setup_storage_error: Couldn't turn on app lock. Try again.
lock_screen.update_wrong_current: That PIN didn't match. Try again.
lock_screen.update_storage_error: Couldn't change your PIN. Try again.
lock_screen.hub_off_body: This protects FreeCBT when someone opens the app on this device. It is not an online account password.
lock_screen.hub_how_it_works_body: Use a four-digit PIN. You can also enable device unlock if your phone supports it.
lock_screen.device_unlock_body: If supported, you can unlock FreeCBT with your phone's screen lock method.
lock_screen.hub_on_title: FreeCBT asks for your PIN when opened
lock_screen.verify_body: Check that you remember your current PIN.
lock_screen.verify_error: That PIN didn't match. Try again.
lock_screen.turn_off_body: FreeCBT will stop asking for a PIN when opened on this device.
lock_screen.turn_off_verify_error: That PIN didn't match. App lock is still on.
lock_screen.storage_error_body: FreeCBT couldn't check your app lock. Your private content remains hidden until you retry.
